package: Autonomous-wildfire: Alaska as proving ground vs. value capture

candidates.story_title: DFFP infrared drone deployed on Mastadon Fire near Talkeetna, 100% containment June 5
key_facts: DFFP UAS Module used infrared drone on Mastadon Fire #131 near Talkeetna
fire reached 100% containment June 5, 2026
size 18.4 acres
infrared flight located residual heat guiding ground crews
second verification flight scheduled following morning

candidates.story_title: XPRIZE $11M autonomous wildfire finals, NANA region mid-June 2026
key_facts: 5 finalists: Anduril, Data Blanket, Dryad, FireSwarm Solutions, Wildfire Quest
NANA Region, ~1,000 sq km, mid-June 2026
AI drone swarms must autonomously detect and suppress fire within 10 minutes
UAF ACUASI is testing partner
$11M total purse

candidates.story_title: HB 217 autonomous-vehicle bill died in Senate Rules at May 20 adjournment
key_facts: HB 217 would require physically present human safety operator in commercial self-driving vehicles
passed House 39-1 April 30
held in Senate Rules, died at May 20 adjournment
no AK state AV framework through 2027

candidates.story_title: GCI Aleutian subsea fiber break, 6 communities on satellite backup
key_facts: subsea cable fault near Chignik Bay May 27
6 communities: Akutan, Chignik Bay, False Pass, King Cove, Perryville, Unalaska
GCI on GEO/LEO satellite backup at degraded capacity
repair vessel expected ~June 6, restore 7-14 days
third Aleutian cable incident in ~6 months

candidates.story_title: DOE tribal grid resilience grants: 91 AK tribes got <6% of $58M
key_facts: 91 AK tribal entities promised $58M DOE Grid Resilience State & Tribal Formula Grants
received under 6%
White Mountain owed $571,759, spent ~$700K, no reimbursement
disbursements stalled under federal funding freeze
